newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Komunalna to launch recepits, bonds in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Komunalna to launch recepits, bonds in 1997.

text.p: Slovak bank Prva Komunalna Banka a.s (PKB) on Friday said it planned to issue a tranche of 500 million crowns worth of depositary receipts, the TASR news agency reported.
TASR added that the bank's shareholders also approved launching a one billion crown tranche of bonds next year.
Further details on either issue were not immediately available. Company officials were also not immediately available for comment.
The bank has a network of branches that operate in 26 of Slovakia's towns, TASR said.
It said the bank has been focusing mainly in issuing credits and cooperating with the municipalitites, and has so far provided loans totalling to 1.6 billion crowns.
TASR added that shareholders had also approved raising the bank's capital by 500 million crowns to 1.002 billion, through an issue of non-publicly traded shares. It did not elaborate.
The share issue is one of the first step towards the bank's goal to be granted a licence for providing mortage loans, TASR said.
